verse: Be still, and know that I am God.
Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.
Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you... Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.
The Lord gives strength to his people; the Lord blesses his people with peace.
You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.
I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.
Do not be anxious about anything... present your requests to God. And the peace of God... will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing... he leads me beside quiet waters, he refreshes my soul.
Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
Let your eyes look straight ahead; fix your gaze directly before you.
Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord.
The plans of the diligent lead to profit as surely as haste leads to poverty.
Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
Stand firm. Let nothing move you. Always give yourselves fully to the work of the Lord.
Run in such a way as to get the prize.
Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest.
I can do all this through him who gives me strength.
For I know the plans I have for you, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
Those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles.
The Lord is my light and my salvation — whom shall I fear?
Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged.
In all things God works for the good of those who love him.
He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
Do to others as you would have them do to you.
Clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.
Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt.
A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure... think about such things.
Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
So in everything, do to others what you would have them do to you.
